profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Seasoned software engineer with a background in language runtimes and cloud computing, and a passion for performance.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built the Azure Data Lake Storage Query Acceleration feature: a distributed query engine integrated directly into Azure Storage, for efficient queries across large data sets without an existing index.  

Worked closely with Microsoft Research to make use of the latest fast parsing techniques, to develop new ways of distributing data parsing and query execution across nodes in a distributed system, and to develop a roadmap for taking advantage of new hardware developments to become even more cost effective in the future.  

Worked with the Azure security team to develop infrastructure for executing customer queries safely sandboxed within the Azure Storage core.  

Developed work-scheduling algorithms for efficient distribution of query processing across Azure Storage nodes. 

Provided technical leadership to a small team of developers and program managers to bring this feature to market with support for our customers' key requirements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the compiler, runtime, and platform integration for Apex, Salesforce's custom language for customer-provided extensions to the Salesforce platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained low-level threading, concurrency, and synchronization support in the Common Language Runtime (CLR), along with the .NET thread pool. 

Was a key contributor to the design of the Task Parallel Library (TPL), the async/await feature of C# and VB, and the supporting runtime infrastructure. 

Greatly increased the multicore scalability of the .NET thread pool's work scheduling algorithms, using low-lock techniques, including some novel improvements to traditional lock-free data structures. 
Developed an adaptive thread management algorithm for the .NET thread pool, using techniques from Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and control theory. 

Rationalized the CLR memory ordering model for the ARM processor architecture.. 

Contributed to porting CoreCLR to OSX, Linux, and Windows Phone. 

Contributed to CLR 4, 4.5, 4.6, 4.6.1; Silverlight 2 for Windows and Mac OSX; CoreCLR for Windows Phone 8, .NET Native for Windows 10 UWP apps, .NET Core, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed backend services for Hotmail / Windows Live (now Outlook.com).  Built massive-scale, high-reliability, high-availability services on Solaris, FreeBSD, and Windows.  Worked on a variety of technologies, including spam filtering, storage, indexing/search, geodistributed scalable storage, and live site monitoring.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description: Developed automated functional and stress tests for network Quality of Service (QoS) components in Windows 2000, including the kernel network packet scheduler, and the user RSVP protocol implementation.

projects.title: .NET CLR
projects.description: Runtime environment for turning intermediate language instructions (produced by compilers such as C#, J#, IronPython, etc.) into native executable instructions, including abstracting away system-specific details (threads, memory) and allowing for making native function calls down to the "bare metal".

publications.title: Speculative Distributed CSV Data Parsing for Big Data Analytics
Applying control theory in the real world: experience with building a controller for the .NET thread pool
publications.publisher: ACM SIGMETRICS Performance Evaluation Review · Jan 1, 2009

patents.title: Rule-based System for Client-Side Quality-of-Service Tracking and Reporting
Async Wrapper Handling Execution of Asynchronous Operations for Sychronous and Asynchronous Routines
